source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Spaces Manifest V2 uses empty strings or arrays for resets, and the update implementation ignores null values produced for absent optional inputs. Manifest V3 uses omit-key-if-missing so absent keys preserve state and explicit null requests a reset. The update code clones the old properties before applying supplied entries. The 729 schema reorganization is cosmetic and preserves this contract. Do not replace it with a broad null-coalescing assignment that loses explicit reset requests.
title: Preserve missing-versus-reset semantics in spaces updates
